title: Use SSMS-like Container Selection screen to find a tote by location/number and interpret rack/tote color states
summary: Use the application screen labeled “Container Selection 1 Totes” to (1) interpret rack/tile color states (dark blue vs light blue) for tote presence vs empty rack, and (2) locate a specific tote by typing a location/number (e.g., “Location 11801070 number”) and selecting the rack/AGV tile so the tote number appears with a box icon.
when_to_use: When you need to identify whether a rack/tile has an AG tote present (dark blue) or is empty (light blue), and/or when you need to locate a specific tote by entering its location/number and selecting the corresponding rack/AGV tile so the tote number is displayed with a box icon.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the Container Selection screen lookup by entering the location/number and selecting the correct rack/AGV tile; interpret the dark blue vs light blue rack/tile state and confirm the tote number display after selection.
safety_notes: Do not attempt to remove an AGV/tote from this screen unless you have the appropriate access/credentials; the source notes that operators may not have the credentials and that removing an AGV is considered the worst action.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the application screen labeled “Container Selection 1 Totes”
Ability to type a location/number into the Container Selection search field
Ability to select a rack or AGV tile on the Container Selection screen

access_required: Access to the application screen labeled “Container Selection 1 Totes”
system_preconditions: The Container Selection screen is available and shows the rack/tote grid with dark blue and light blue tiles.

visual_references.description: Container Selection 1 Totes screen frame showing rack/tile color meaning (dark blue tote present vs light blue empty rack) and the location/number lookup text.

steps.title: Open the Container Selection screen (Container Selection 1 Totes)
steps.purpose: Get to the UI where rack/tile color states and tote lookup by location/number are shown.
steps.instruction: Open the application screen labeled “Container Selection 1 Totes Container x [0]”.
steps.expected_result: You can see the Container Selection grid/tiles for racks/containers and the location/number lookup area on the Container Selection screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The screen shows rack/tile color states (dark blue and light blue) and the location/number lookup field is available.
steps.failure_condition: The Container Selection screen is not accessible or the rack/tile grid and location/number lookup field are not visible.

actions.label: Open Container Selection 1 Totes
actions.exact_action: Open the Container Selection screen labeled “Container Selection 1 Totes”.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR indicates a Container Selection screen titled “Container Selection 1 Totes …” with rack/tile color coding and a location/number lookup.

steps.title: Interpret rack/tile color state (dark blue vs light blue)
steps.purpose: Determine whether a rack/tile has an AG tote present or is empty.
steps.instruction: On the Container Selection grid, interpret the rack/tile color: dark blue indicates an AG tote is present; light blue indicates an empty rack.
steps.expected_result: For the rack/tile you are checking, you can correctly identify whether it is dark blue (tote present) or light blue (empty rack).
steps.healthy_condition: Dark blue tiles correspond to racks with a tote present; light blue tiles correspond to empty racks.
steps.failure_condition: A tile’s color state does not match what you expect for tote presence (e.g., you expect a tote but the tile appears light blue).

actions.label: Check tile color
actions.exact_action: Confirm whether the relevant rack/tile is dark blue (presence of an AG tote) or light blue (empty rack).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: “Dark blue indicates the presence of a ag tote. While light blue represents empty … rack.”

steps.title: Find a tote by typing the location/number and selecting the rack/AGV
steps.purpose: Locate a specific tote when you know its location/number.
steps.instruction: Type the location/number (example shown: “Location 11801070 number”) into the Container Selection location/number field, then select the rack or AGV tile where the tote is located (if it is in the system).
steps.expected_result: After selecting the correct rack/AGV tile, the tote number is displayed with a box icon.
steps.healthy_condition: The selected tile updates to show a box icon and the tote number.
steps.failure_condition: After selection, the tote does not appear as present (dark blue) or the tote number does not display with the box icon.

actions.label: Enter location/number
actions.exact_action: Type the “Location 11801070 number” into the location/number field.

actions.label: Select the rack/AGV tile
actions.exact_action: Select the rack or AGV tile where it’s located in the system.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the expected tote does not appear as present (dark blue) or the tote number does not display after selection, stop and escalate (the source provides no further troubleshooting steps).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: “You can also find a tote by typing the … Location 11801070 number in and selecting the rack or AGV … it’s located on if its in the system.”

steps.title: Verify tote selection shows box icon and tote number
steps.purpose: Confirm the correct tote/rack selection result in the UI.
steps.instruction: After selecting the rack/AGV tile, verify that a box icon appears and that the tote number is displayed.
steps.expected_result: A box icon appears and the tote number is shown for the selected rack/tile.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI shows the box icon and the tote number after the tile selection.
steps.failure_condition: No box icon appears and/or the tote number is not displayed after selecting the tile.

actions.label: Confirm box icon + tote number
actions.exact_action: Verify that a box icon appears and that the tote number is displayed after selecting the container/rack tile.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the tote number does not display after selection, stop and escalate (the source provides no further troubleshooting steps).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: “If you select it, a box icon will show … as well as the tote number …”

success_criteria: You can interpret the rack/tile color state: dark blue = AG tote present; light blue = empty rack.
After entering the location/number and selecting the correct rack/AGV tile, the UI shows a box icon and the tote number.
healthy_conditions: Dark blue tiles correspond to racks with a tote present.
Light blue tiles correspond to empty racks.
Selecting the correct tile results in a box icon and tote number display.
failure_conditions: The expected tote does not appear as present (dark blue).
After selecting the rack/AGV tile, the tote number does not display and/or the box icon does not appear.
escalation_guidance: If the expected tote does not appear as present (dark blue) or the tote number does not display after selection, stop and escalate via the appropriate support path. The source provides no further troubleshooting steps.
